# Act the field (world.act)

## categories

[
  "world",
  "phenomena"
]

## demonstrations

[
  {
    "deterministic": false,
    "explanation": "Runs the real supervisor-owned field when configured; changing controls or advancing has persistent effects. Builder self-tests inject an unavailable fake (available=false), never a simulated observation.",
    "id": "act",
    "input": {
      "drive": 3,
      "x": 2,
      "y": 2
    },
    "title": "Try world.act"
  }
]

## description

Set drive at the chosen zero-based coordinate, replacing that control until changed again. Returns the field immediately; no simulation time passes. Observe and advance to inspect consequences. The field is 6 by 6; coordinates run from 0 to 5. The complete state belongs to the supervisor and cannot be rewritten by workspace programs. Configuration must enable the phenomena service. No filesystem, network or other host permission is granted.

## failure_modes

  {

    "recovery": "Check discovered documentation and use valid, bounded controls. Only experiment configuration grants availability.",
    "symptom": "A recorded denial or error with no field change."
  }
]
